items.heading: Explains the four phases in the coarseness that are the secret of the four vessels, and their root. And it contains eight matters: — 1. In all the worlds there is, in the Sefirot of that world, a self and vessels. 2. First the light of Ein Sof expanded in the secret of vessels, and afterward the lights clothed in them. 3. The expansion of the light indicates a greater coarsening than it had before, meaning that the light coarsened and became ten vessels. 4. A screen is made in the vessel of Malchut. 5. This screen separates the world of Atzilut from the world of Beria. 6. The coupling by striking of the light of Ein Sof in the screen raises reflected light from below upward. 7. The place to which the light of Ein Sof reaches is the world of Atzilut. 8. Four phases in the coarsening of the upper light: a) in its expansion from Keter to Hochma; b) in its expansion to Bina, in which a distancing is added; c) in its expansion to Zeir Anpin, in which a window and narrow hole are made; d) in its expansion to Malchut, in which a narrow hole and a distancing are made. — There is a self and vessels. First the light of Ein Sof expanded in the secret of vessels. And afterward the lights, which are the self, clothed in them.
items.html: *1In all the worlds there is the phase of 2self 3and vessels. 4And first of all, 5Ein Sof 6expanded in the secret of the ten Sefirot of Atzilut, in the secret of vessels, for the matter of 7expansion indicates 8a coarsening of the light greater than it was before. Thus these ten Sefirot are ten vessels, and they came about by the expansion of the Ein Sof Himself, 9only that the light coarsened, and vessels were made through expansion. And after this expansion, by which ten vessels are made, then 10the self of Ein Sof clothed within them. And this is the secret of self and vessels.

items.heading: The correction of the screen to detain the upper light from expanding into the vessel of Malchut. And it separates the world of Atzilut from the rest of the worlds.
items.html: 20Now when the aforementioned expansion reached Malchut of Atzilut, the upper Emanator saw 30that the lower ones had no power to receive that light if it expanded further, and then 40when the tenth vessel of Atzilut was completed, 50a screen and a single curtain were made there, 60which separates Atzilut from the rest of the worlds below it.

items.heading: By the power of the striking of the light of Ein Sof in the screen, the light returns upward in the secret of reflected light that clothes the upper light. Up to the place the line of the light of Ein Sof reaches is called the world of Atzilut.
items.html: 70Then the light of Ein Sof, blessed be He, which expanded to there, struck in that screen, and then, 80by the power of the striking of the descent, having reached there, it returned to rise 90in the secret of reflected light, upward to its place, 100and then the world of Atzilut was completed in the phase of the vessels, 200and then the Ein Sof returned to clothe within them in the secret of the self, as above, therefore 300the place to which the light of Ein Sof reaches, in the manner aforesaid, is called the world of Atzilut: 400for it is the light itself, only that it is after its coarsening, as above.

items.heading: Four phases in the coarsening of the upper light: a) reception from the one above, which is Hochma. b) a distancing from Hochma, which is Bina. c) a window and a narrow hole, which is Zeir Anpin. d) a distancing from Hochma and a narrow hole, which is Malchut.
items.html: 1And the matter of this coarsening of the light is that one who sees a very great light cannot bear it, unless by way of a distancing, or by way of a screen, or by way of both. 2Now Keter in Atzilut, the Ein Sof shines in it without any screen and without any distancing at all, therefore Keter is called Ein Sof. 3And Hochma receives through Keter. 4But Bina receives the light of Ein Sof by way of a distancing, 5for now the Ein Sof is distant from her and she is able to receive it. 6And Zeir Anpin does not receive the light except through a window and a narrow hole, within which window the very self of the light passes without any screen at all, only that the way is not wide but very narrow, 7yet it is close, 8for from Bina to Zeir Anpin is not distant. But 9the Nukva of Zeir Anpin, the light is extended to her through a hole and a window, like Zeir Anpin, only that it is by way of a distancing.
